LanguageData.CC_SeeCouncilTab: See the Council tab for details.
LanguageData.CC_NotNow_Tip: Politely set this wish aside. No mood penalty. They won't ask for the same thing again for a while.
LanguageData.CC_NoGame: Start or load a game to hear from the council.
LanguageData.CC_NoHomeMap: The council meets in your home settlement. Open a colony map to see its advice.
LanguageData.CC_Era: Era: {0}. Electricity: {1}. Advice only suggests things your colony can actually build.
LanguageData.CC_Priorities_AllGood: Nothing pressing right now. The council is pleasantly bored. Check the Ambition tab for something to work towards.
LanguageData.CC_AdvisorDisabled: The advisor is switched off in the mod settings.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_NoBeds_Detail: {0} sleep on the ground. Even {1} would stop the nightly mood penalty.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Barracks_Detail: {0} would sleep better (and be happier) in rooms of their own.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_FoodLow_Title: Food runs out in about {0} days
LanguageData.CC_Adv_FoodLow_Detail: Hunt, forage, harvest anything ripe, or buy food from traders. Cooking meals stretches raw food further than eating it raw.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Winter_Title: The growing season ends in about {0} days
LanguageData.CC_Adv_WinterNow_Title: Lean season: about {0} days until crops grow again
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Winter_Detail: You have about {0} days of food. To get through the {2}-day cold spell you'll want around {1}.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Winter_Hydro: A greenhouse with {0} would let you grow food all year.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Winter_NoHydro: Plant more now, hunt before the animals migrate, and trade for food.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Freezer_Title: Food is spoiling without a freezer
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Freezer_Detail: {0} pieces of perishable food are stored warm. A closed room kept below freezing with {1} keeps it fresh.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Spoil_Detail: {0} pieces of perishable food are stored warm. Eat perishables first, store food in the coldest room you have, and don't overstock raw food in summer.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Spoil_Preserve: {0} pieces of perishable food are stored warm. Turn surplus into {1}, which keeps far longer, and eat perishables first.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Cold_Detail: You have {0} heat source(s). Plan {1} for the bedrooms and workrooms before the cold arrives.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_WarmClothes_Title: {0} colonist(s) aren't dressed for the cold
LanguageData.CC_Adv_WarmClothes_Detail: {0} will be uncomfortable at {1}. Make warmer clothes (parkas, tribalwear, dusters) before then.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Hot_Detail: You have {0} cooler(s). Plan {1} for the bedrooms to prevent heatstroke.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Defense_TitleBad: Your defences may not hold the next raid
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Defense_Detail: Raids are currently worth about {0} points. You have {1} fighter(s), {2} turret(s), {3} trap(s) and {4} pieces of cover.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Defense_Growth: Colony wealth grew {0} in the last 15 days, so raids will grow too.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Defense_Suggest: Next step: about {0} more {1}, placed where raiders approach.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Defense_SuggestTrain: Next step: better weapons and some shooting practice.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_NoDoctor_Detail: Enable Doctor in the Work tab for at least one colonist, ideally your best at Medicine.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Medicine_Detail: Buy medicine from traders, or research how to make it. Even a few doses save lives.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Medicine_Grow: Grow {0} to make herbal medicine, and buy better medicine when traders visit.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Hospital_Detail: After one bad raid, the injured will lie wherever they fall. A small hospital (a few beds set to "medical") is a lifesaver.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_PowerShort_Title: The power grid is running out
LanguageData.CC_Adv_PowerShort_Detail: The grid uses about {0} W more than it produces and the batteries are nearly empty. Add generators or switch things off.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_SolarOnly_Detail: Every night (and every eclipse) the power goes out. Batteries or a second kind of generator fix that.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_NoBattery_Detail: Batteries store surplus power for when generators dip. Handy for freezers.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_NoPower_Title: The colony has electricity research but no power
LanguageData.CC_Adv_NoPower_Detail: Something like {0} would power lights, better workbenches and coolers.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Rec_Title: Recreation is thin ({0} kinds, colonists want {1})
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Rec_Suggest: Adding {0} would give them something new ({1}).
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Dining_Detail: Colonists eat without a table and lose mood at every meal. Put {0} and some chairs in a room.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Work_Detail: Nobody is assigned to {0}. Check the Work tab.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Rot_Detail: Items left under the open sky slowly fall apart. Put a roof over your stockpile.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Rot_DetailShelf: Items left under the open sky slowly fall apart. A roofed room with some shelving ({0}) fixes it.
LanguageData.CC_Adv_Research_Detail: Suggested next project for your era: {0} (cost {1}).
LanguageData.CC_Idea_RecRoom_Title: Idea: a room just for fun
LanguageData.CC_Idea_RecRoom_Detail: A dedicated recreation room gives a mood bonus every time someone relaxes there.
LanguageData.CC_Idea_Dining_Title: Idea: dress up the dining room
LanguageData.CC_Idea_Dining_Detail: A more impressive dining room gives a mood boost after every meal. Floors, art and good furniture help.
LanguageData.CC_Idea_Barn_Title: Idea: give the animals a barn
LanguageData.CC_Idea_Barn_Detail: Animals sleeping outside get cold and sick. A barn with sleeping spots keeps them healthy.
LanguageData.CC_Idea_Era_Detail: Your colony is settled. Research like {0} opens new possibilities.
LanguageData.CC_Idea_Empire_Detail: The Empire hands out titles for favours. A noble colonist brings powerful perks, and expensive tastes.
LanguageData.CC_Wishes_None: Nobody is asking for anything right now. Enjoy it while it lasts.
LanguageData.CC_WishesDisabled: Wishes are switched off in the mod settings.
LanguageData.CC_Listen_Tip: Ask around. If anyone has a wish, they'll speak up now. (Once a day.)
LanguageData.CC_Listen_Cooldown: You already asked today. Give them some time.
LanguageData.CC_Listen_Nothing: You asked around, but nobody wants anything right now.
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_Short_Gentle: Gentle mode: granted wishes lift mood, ignored ones cost nothing.
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_Short_Balanced: Balanced mode: granting helps, ignoring stings, and others notice who gets what.
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_Short_Demanding: Demanding mode: broken promises and favouritism bite hard, and bitter colonists may sulk.
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_Short_AdvisorOnly: Advisor-only mode: wishes are suggestions, with no mood effects.
LanguageData.CC_ForOtherFallback: {FOR_nameDef} could really use this: {WISH}. Could we see to it?
LanguageData.CC_InspirationReason: {PAWN_nameDef} is inspired now that {PAWN_possessive} wish ({WISH}) has come true.
LanguageData.CC_PetitionGranted: The petition is answered. {0} are pleased too.
LanguageData.CC_CoSignLine_Warm: {PAWN_nameDef} is right, you know. I'd love that too.
LanguageData.CC_CoSignLine_Gloomy: {PAWN_nameDef} asked. I'm asking too. Not that it'll help.
LanguageData.CC_CoSignLine_Cold: {PAWN_nameDef}'s request is sensible. I support it.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_NoBed: {PAWN_nameDef} has no bed and sleeps wherever {PAWN_pronoun} drops.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_SleepsOutside: {PAWN_nameDef}'s bed isn't even inside a room.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Jealous: {PAWN_nameDef} is jealous: someone else has a nicer bedroom.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Greedy: {PAWN_nameDef} is greedy and wants a bedroom that shows it.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_HighExpectations: The colony is doing well, and {PAWN_nameDef}'s expectations have risen with it.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_SleepApart: {PAWN_nameDef} and {OTHER_nameDef} are partners but sleep in different beds.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_BareRoom: {PAWN_nameDef}'s room is bare and {PAWN_pronoun} expects a bit more these days.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_NightOwl: {PAWN_nameDef} is a night owl and spends a lot of time awake in the dark.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Dark: {PAWN_nameDef} keeps ending up in the dark and hates it.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_AteWithoutTable: {PAWN_nameDef} had to eat without a table.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Bored: {PAWN_nameDef} is bored: the colony has {1} kinds of recreation, {PAWN_pronoun} wants {2}.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Passion: {SKILL} is {PAWN_nameDef}'s {PASSION}, but the colony has no proper place for it.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_WorkOff: {PAWN_nameDef} is passionate about {SKILL}, but {WORK} is switched off for {PAWN_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Brawler: {PAWN_nameDef} is a brawler and hates being stuck with a ranged weapon.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Fighter: {PAWN_nameDef} lives to fight and wants a weapon worthy of it.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Chemical: {PAWN_nameDef} has a chemical interest. Strong drink is a long-standing hobby.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_AteRaw: {PAWN_nameDef} has been eating raw food or paste.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_CookFreezer: {PAWN_nameDef} cooks, and watches the ingredients spoil.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Clothes_dead: {PAWN_nameDef} is wearing clothes taken from the dead.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_MissingPart: {PAWN_nameDef} lost {PAWN_possessive} {PART}, and a replacement is within the colony's reach.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_AnimalLover: {PAWN_nameDef} loves animals, and there are {ANIMALS} roaming nearby.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Unsafe: {PAWN_nameDef} has seen too much violence and doesn't feel safe.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Tactician: {PAWN_nameDef} is a fighter and sees weak spots in the colony's defences.
LanguageData.CC_Reason_RoyalThrone: {PAWN_nameDef}'s title ({TITLE}) requires a throne room with: {LIST}
LanguageData.CC_Reason_Child: {PAWN_nameDef} is a child and has nothing of {PAWN_possessive} own to learn or play with.

LanguageData.CC_When_Passion_Cooking: A cooking station stands in a room that counts as a kitchen.

LanguageData.CC_Ambition_AchievedText: The colony set out to achieve "{0}" and did it in {1} days. Everyone feels the lift.
LanguageData.CC_Ambition_Inspired: {PAWN_nameDef} is inspired after seeing {PAWN_possessive} proposal come true.

LanguageData.CC_Meeting_TooSoon: The council met very recently. Try again in {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_NoOne: Nobody is free to attend a meeting right now.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_NothingToPropose: The council met, but nobody had anything new to propose. Things must be going well.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_Intro: The colonists talked it over {0}, in between other things. These proposals stood out:
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_IntroGathered: The council met {VENUE}, with {CHAIR} keeping order. {COUNT} turned up: {NAMES}. They argued, they joked, somebody brought snacks. These proposals stood out:
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_Leans: The room leans towards {AMBITION}, {PAWN_nameDef}'s idea. Go with it and its backers will be pleased; overrule a clear majority and they'll remember.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_Split: The room is split. Nobody will hold the decision against you.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_AlreadyCalled: A meeting has already been called.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_Gathering: {PAWN_nameDef} calls the council together {VENUE}. On the table: {TOPICS}. Colonists will drift over to have their say; the decision comes when the meeting ends.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_BrokenUp: The council meeting broke up early. They'll try again when things calm down.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_InSession: The council is meeting {0} right now ({1} so far). On the table: {2}.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_Called: A meeting has been called (about {0}). It starts when the colony is calm, preferably in the evening.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_Outro: Which should the colony commit to? Achieving it lifts everyone's mood and their trust in the council. Choosing none costs little.
LanguageData.CC_Meeting_Unavailable: The colony is already working on another ambition.

LanguageData.CC_Log_Overruled: outvoted the council, yet {0} was overruled

LanguageData.CC_Heckle_Warm: {PAWN_nameDef} thanked everyone for coming, and said {OTHER_nameDef}'s idea ("{AMBITION}") sounded lovely.
LanguageData.CC_Heckle_Blunt: {PAWN_nameDef} snorted at {OTHER_nameDef}'s "{AMBITION}" and asked who was going to do the actual work.
LanguageData.CC_Heckle_Cheerful: {PAWN_nameDef} cheered so loudly for "{AMBITION}" that {OTHER_nameDef} looked embarrassed.
LanguageData.CC_Heckle_Gloomy: {PAWN_nameDef} muttered that "{AMBITION}" wouldn't matter when the next raid came.
LanguageData.CC_Heckle_Cold: {PAWN_nameDef} calmly pointed out every flaw in {OTHER_nameDef}'s "{AMBITION}". Twice.

LanguageData.CC_Build_Sub: Templates adapt to your tech and materials. Click "Plan": a panel lets you turn and mirror the room, move the door, pick materials and furniture. The same rooms are in the architect menu under "rooms".
LanguageData.CC_Template_NoWalls: The colony can't build walls yet.
LanguageData.CC_Template_Missing: Not yet possible: the colony can't build {0}.

LanguageData.CC_Plan_WillMine: {0} rock cell(s) will be mined out.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_SpotFound: The council suggests a spot for the {0} (yellow outline). Use "Place it there" in the panel, or click anywhere you like.
LanguageData.CC_Plan_NoSpot: The council couldn't find a good spot for the {0} near the colony. Place it by hand.

LanguageData.CC_Planner_CutPlants_Tip: Marks plants in the walls, under furniture and inside the room for cutting (ripe crops and trees are harvested). Fields inside the room are taken out of the growing zone.
LanguageData.CC_Planner_MineRock_Tip: Rock inside the room, in the doorway and right outside the door is marked for mining. Rock in the walls is kept as wall. Furniture on mined cells is planned once the rock is gone.
LanguageData.CC_Planner_ReplaceOwn: Replace my buildings in the way
LanguageData.CC_Planner_ReplaceOwn_Tip: Your own buildings inside the room or in its walls are marked for deconstruction, and the plan follows once they're gone. Off by default for a reason.
LanguageData.CC_Planner_Smooth_Tip: Natural rock walls and rough stone floors are marked for smoothing. Smooth stone is pretty and costs nothing but time.
LanguageData.CC_Planner_Free: Nothing to buy: it's all there already.

LanguageData.CC_Chronicle_Touch: {0} planned a new {1} for their bedroom.
LanguageData.CC_Alert_WishesDesc: These colonists are waiting on a wish. Granting it lifts their mood; ignoring it costs nothing in Gentle mode.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_EnableAdvisor: Advisor: rank what the colony needs
LanguageData.CC_Settings_EnableAdvisor_Tip: Shows prioritized, explained advice on the Council tab's Priorities page.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_EnableWishes_Tip: Colonists voice wishes based on their traits, passions, relationships and mood.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_EnableAmbitions_Tip: Every so often the council meets and colonists pitch a bigger goal for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_EnableTouches_Tip: Colonists occasionally plan a small piece of furniture for their own bedroom (as a normal blueprint you can cancel).
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_Gentle_Tip: Only upsides. Granted wishes and achieved ambitions lift mood; ignoring a wish, refusing it or failing an ambition costs nothing. Trust is still tracked, but only its good side has effects.
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_Balanced_Tip: Upsides and downsides. Ignored wishes and refusals sting, broken promises sting more, colonists who waited longer feel passed over, the jealous resent favourites, and ignored colonists can turn disgruntled and work slower. Granted wishes can leave people motivated.
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_Demanding_Tip: Like Balanced, with every penalty 50% stronger. Bitter, unhappy colonists may storm off to sulk or go on an insulting spree.
LanguageData.CC_Stakes_AdvisorOnly_Tip: No mood effects from this mod at all. Wishes and ambitions are pure suggestions.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ForOthers: Kind colonists can ask on behalf of others
LanguageData.CC_Settings_ForOthers_Tip: A kind colonist may notice someone else's hardship and ask for them. Both are happier if it's granted.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_Petitions_Tip: Colonists who want the same thing back each other's wish instead of making a new one.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_WishLetters_Tip: Off: new wishes appear as short messages instead.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_GrantedLetters_Tip: Off (default): a short message when a wish comes true.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_SpeechText_Tip: Shows a short line above a colonist when they make, back or get a wish, or pitch an ambition.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_AdvisorAlert_Tip: Shows the council's most urgent concern in the alerts on the right.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_WishAlert_Tip: Shows a reminder in the alerts while colonists are waiting on wishes.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_Jealousy_Tip: When a wish comes true, the jealous, the greedy, rivals and those who have waited longer may resent it, and some will ask for the same thing.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_EventWishes_Tip: Raids, deaths, cold nights, meals eaten off the floor and the like make colonists speak up within hours, about the thing that just happened.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_Reminders_Tip: Halfway through, colonists bring their wish up again; near the end they make a last, pointed call.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_SelfHelp: Colonists take matters into their own hands
LanguageData.CC_Settings_SelfHelp_Tip: Hard-working, handy colonists who run out of patience sometimes sort it out themselves: they plan the lamp, switch their own work back on, mark out a grave, pick an animal to tame.
LanguageData.CC_Promise_Tip: Tell them you'll see to it. They wait half again as long and trust the council a little more. If it doesn't happen in time, it's a broken promise: much worse than never promising.
LanguageData.CC_Refuse_Tip: Say no, honestly. It stings now (less for kind or ascetic colonists) but it's over: no reminders, no slow souring, and they won't ask again for a long while.
LanguageData.CC_Refuse_Confirm: Refuse {PAWN_nameDef}'s wish for {WISH}? It will disappoint {PAWN_objective}, and {PAWN_pronoun} won't ask for it again for a while.
LanguageData.CC_LastCallMessage: {PAWN_nameDef} is running out of patience about {WISH} ({TIME} left).
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_Plan: Tired of waiting, {PAWN_nameDef} planned {THING} for the room {PAWN_pronoun} sleeps in. The builders will find the blueprint; cancel it if you object.
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_ShareBed: {PAWN_nameDef} has moved into {OTHER_nameDef}'s bed. Nobody asked the council. Nobody had to.
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_Grave: {PAWN_nameDef} marked out a grave for {OTHER_nameDef}. Once it's dug, the body can be laid to rest.
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_Tame: {PAWN_nameDef} picked out an animal ({SUBJECT}) and marked it for taming. If {PAWN_pronoun} isn't allowed to handle animals, someone else will have to.
LanguageData.CC_SelfHelp_Work: {PAWN_nameDef} switched {PAWN_possessive} own {SUBJECT} work back on. You can switch it off again in the Work tab, if you're willing to have that conversation.
LanguageData.CC_PromiseKeptNote: A promise kept. {PAWN_nameDef} won't forget it.
LanguageData.CC_Trust_Sub: Grows when wishes come true and promises are kept; falls when they're ignored, refused or broken. Trusting colonists are patient and content; bitter ones grumble, stop asking and (on Demanding) may sulk. Hover a name for the history.

LanguageData.CC_Chronicle_SelfHelp: {0} stopped waiting for {1} and saw to it alone.
LanguageData.CC_Chronicle_PassedOver: {0} colonist(s) felt passed over when {1} got {2}.
LanguageData.CC_Almanac_AllDlc: Show pages for DLCs I don't have
